item.coloph: bdag 'dra snyigs ma'i kho bo sangs rgyas gling pas lho tsha ba rong gi sbas yul pad ma 'bum gling nub phyogs suH sa mo bya yi lo gnas mchog nam mkha'i mdzod kyi g.yon phyogs mi shig rdo rje dpal phug nas gter nas drangs zhing (shing /)slar lcags pho khyi'i lo shar rgyal mo rgya'i rong gi nye ba'i gdan sa chen mo bkra shis smin grol gling du shog ser las zhal bshus grub pa'o//
